* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar CesarVialpando.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Customs Fast Track|Customs Fast Track]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar CesarVialpando.png]]CJ's garage, Doherty, San Fierro

In this mission you need to steal a car driven by a woman that won't stop for anything short of wrecking her car.  You get a special car modded with 3 "stingers", which are like police stop-sticks.  Follow the target indicator (heading South on the freeway) and drop a stinger in front of her car.  Once you hop out of your car, a cutscene will play as you fix the tires.  Then, head back to the garage.

== Rewards ==

* '''Cash''': $5,000
* '''Respect''': +5
* Wang Cars becomes an asset
